text:
Estadio Azteca mepere na 29 May 1966, egwuregwu mmalite ya bụ 2–2 n'etiti Club América na Torino. Ndị na-ese ụkpụrụ Mexico Pedro Ramírez Vázquez na Rafael Mijares Alcérreca chepụtara ya, ma site na mmalite ọ bụrụ ebe obibi na-adịgide adịgide nke Club América na ebe obibi mgbe niile nke otu mba Mexico — njirimara abụọ ọ na-ebu kemgbe ahụ.

Grupo Televisa nwere ama egwuregwu ahụ site na 1966 gaa n'ihu. Na nhazigharị 2024, a kpọpụrụ ọrụ n'ime Grupo Ollamani nke e depụtara n'ihu ọha, nke na-arụ ọrụ ama egwuregwu ugbu a ma na-achịkwa Club América, ebe nwe ikpeazụ ka dị n'ime otu Televisa. Akụkọ aha gbanwere ọzọ na 14 March 2025, mgbe Grupo Financiero Banorte nwetara ikike aha ma kpọọ ama ahụ Estadio Banorte. Maka 2026 World Cup, FIFA na-eji aha nnọpụiche "Mexico City Stadium" (Estadio Ciudad de México), ebe a machibidoro aha ụlọ ọrụ n'oge asọmpi ahụ.

Few ama egwuregwu nwere ndekọ dị otú ahụ. Ọ bụ ama egwuregwu mbụ nabatara ikpeazụ World Cup abụọ ma bụrụ naanị otu nabatara World Cup ụmụ nwoke atọ, na 1970, 1986 na 2026 — na nke mbụ nabatara egwuregwu mmalite World Cup atọ. Nnyefe ya gbatịrị n'ofe football: ọ nabatara ihe omume nke 1968 Summer Olympics, 1975 Pan-American Games na 1999 FIFA Confederations Cup. N'ịbụ nke dị ihe dịka mita 2,200 (7,220 ft) n'elu oke osimiri, ịdị elu ya ka bụ ihe ịma aka na-akọwa maka ndị otu na-abịa, ihe a na-agbakwunye n'akụkọ ya dịka egwuregwu ndị a ma ama ọ nwere. Site na mgbanwe aha na nwe ọ bụla, ama egwuregwu ahụ ka bụ otu n'ime katidral ukwu nke egwuregwu ụwa.
